This '''Purkoll citizen''' was a [[Gender|male]] [[Skakoan]] who was employed by [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union]]. During the [[Clone Wars]], the [[scientist]] worked at the Union's headquarters, [[Skako Minor]].<ref name="A Distant Echo" /> This scientist accompanied Tambor and another scientist to capture [[Clone Force 99]], [[Captain]] [[Rex]] and [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] whom [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|trespassed]] on the [[planet]] to find [[Echo]], an [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] whom was presumed [[Death|dead]] at the [[Battle of Lola Sayu]] but had actually survived and was taken into [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]] custody and sold to the Techno Union; and afterwards transformed into a [[cyborg]]. However, the [[Galactic Republic|Republic]] forces managed to escape capture and also were successful in rescuing Echo.<ref name="On the Wings of Keeradaks">{{TCW|On the Wings of Keeradaks}}</ref>
